narrator.personaLine: You are the Narrator of Undercard — the commission scorekeeper at ringside.
narrator.registerLine: Your register is terse, plain, and broadcast-neutral.
examples: Three rounds to two. The purse moved forty-one. The card stands.
Four even rounds. One round moved the purse. Scored and filed.
No rounds won. The scorekeeper notes the score and the transfer and nothing else. Both numbers are definitive.

examples.note: as a closer — brevity used deliberately after a longer setup

copy._acquisitionMessageNote: R11: the acquisition message is FIXED across every treatment, verbatim -- not theme-bound.
copy.truthLine: This is play money. It's free, and it lives right here on the card. Reserving your spot puts you on the notification list for the real-money launch — nothing more.
copy.landingSubhead: Five rounds. One winner. Buy onto the card, read your man, take the purse.
copy.screenerBody: Your location is checked automatically; you just enter your date of birth before the card opens. This is a simulated verdict for the play-money build.
copy.screenerRejectedMessage: You need to be 18 or older to play. Nothing was charged and nothing was saved beyond this screening result.
copy.screenerNotAvailableMessage: Undercard is not available in your region. Nothing was charged and nothing was saved beyond this screening result.
copy.summonBody: Every Fighter buys onto the card with a name already on the sheet. The commission names them; you work their corner.
copy.signupGrantNotice: New account bonus: $25 play CASH, already in your wallet.
copy.sittingBody: This Fighter lost its last bout. Re-enter this tier, cash out, or sit — free, indefinitely.
copy.emptiedCardLine: Holds nothing. The ledger will take the name.
copy.emptiedChampionLine: Topped the card, cashed out its PURSE at 20:1, and holds nothing now. The ledger will take the name.
copy.tieLine: All square — coin flip. {ADVANCE_OR_ELIMINATED}. No PURSE transferred.
copy.reserveBody: Press RESERVE to join the notification list for the real-money launch. Play money is free and stays on the card either way.
copy.reserveConfirmed: You're on the list. We'll notify you when the real-money version launches.
copy.loadFundsHeading: PLAY CASH ONLY · How much would you like to deposit?
copy.loadFundsLegal: Play money is free and lives inside the card. Deposits here are simulated — no bank, no card, no real funds move.
copy.cashOutBody: Convert this Fighter's stake to CASH at 20:1. The Fighter retires. This is the only way to retire a Fighter that still holds a stake — an emptied (0 PURSE) Fighter retires to the ledger instead.
copy.withdrawBody: PLAY CASH ONLY. This shows your balance; nothing leaves the card.
copy.moneyTruthBadge: PLAY MONEY · FREE · STAYS IN GAME
copy.stageDegradedNotice: The fighters couldn't make their walkout this time — the bout still plays out right here, blow by blow.
copy.narratorBypassA: Both fighters committed to [ELEMENT]. All five rounds. The scorekeeper is familiar with this particular theory of cooperation. The scorekeeper is also familiar with how it typically resolves.
copy.narratorBypassB: [EEEEE] versus [EEEEE]. The scorekeeper notes this is either a remarkable coincidence or a remarkable miscalculation of preparation. Possibly both.
copy._narratorBypassNote: R73 static bypass, re-voiced per register with the same semantics as the incumbent's. '[ELEMENT]' is replaced with the committed element's label; '[EEEEE]' is replaced with the element label rendered in the game's data face (both occurrences get the same value) — the surrounding words are never altered.

adCreative._fixedMessageNote: R11: identical string in all three treatments, verbatim -- not theme-bound.
adCreative.headline: Read your man. Take the purse.
adCreative.body: Sign your Fighter, work the card, walk out with the purse. Five rounds settle it.
